description: Read-only day/cosy/night and resolved-current cohort collector. Uses exact final constant payloads, unique physical endpoint identities, and current room power admission. Animated channels remain independent.

variables.existing_groups: {% set n=namespace(groups=[]) %}{% for g in state_attr('sensor.ls_effects_runtime','auto_groups') or [] %}{% set n.groups=n.groups+[dict(g,verified=g.get('friendly_name','')!='fx_candle_active' and not g.get('friendly_name','').startswith('ls_auto_')) if g is mapping else g] %}{% endfor %}{{ n.groups }}
variables.devices: {% set n=namespace(devices={}) %}{% for entity in catalog.members.values()|sum(start=[])|unique|sort %}{% set n.devices=dict(n.devices,**{entity:device_attr(entity,'identifiers') or []}) %}{% endfor %}{{ n.devices }}
